newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose sharply to 2.09 billion yuan from 1.363 billion yuan with the 30-day contract the most active.
Trading was more active mainly due to the strong performance of the domestic A share markets, traders said.
The continuous bull run of A shares triggered some heavy borrowing in the market by securities houses, one said.
But the prospect of a cut in bank reserve ratios soon will prevent the rates from rising in the short term, traders said.
The official Business News said on Tuesday that China was expected to lower bank reserve ratios by three percentage points to 10 percent from the current 13 percent during the second quarter of 1997.
